# Change release/update integration while preserving local work

## Context
Load updates context; relevant implementation is [`select()`](mex://function:178cf7dc1f0edf3ed4290cd20b1ad64f), [`update()`](mex://function:a7f1960294d4505d616aeac277790de0), and [`refresh_install()`](mex://function:9351f411e2179b34ee9962426ee6bb3c). Sources: `scripts/nightshift-update.py:44`, `scripts/nightshift-update.py:68`, `scripts/nightshift-update.py:96`.

## Steps
1. Keep source/channel selection explicit and verify VERSION against the selected stable tag. Source: `scripts/nightshift-update.py:44`.
2. Preserve clean-expected-branch checking and fast-forward-only revision application. Source: `scripts/nightshift-update.py:78`.
3. Retain pending installation receipts across installer failures and ensure repair mode is passed. Sources: `scripts/nightshift-update.py:89`, `scripts/nightshift-update.py:99`.
4. Extend isolated release fixtures for the affected boundary. Source: `tests/test-release-inputs.py:19`.

## Gotchas
Stable versions sort numerically; branch channels are explicit. Pending installer repair runs before revision selection when applying. Sources: `scripts/nightshift-update.py:52`, `scripts/nightshift-update.py:70`.

## Verify
- [ ] Run `python3 tests/test-release-inputs.py`. Source: `tests/test-release-inputs.py:145`.
- [ ] Retain coverage for dirty/feature branches, mismatched tags, active-run locks, and failed installer receipts. Source: `tests/test-release-inputs.py:48`, `tests/test-release-inputs.py:63`, `tests/test-release-inputs.py:77`, `tests/test-release-inputs.py:89`.

## Debug
Inspect the returned status and installer receipt first. Exhaustion records attempts and a reconciliation hint; do not remove user files to force update success. Source: `scripts/nightshift-update.py:110`.
